correctness.rationale: For fixed hub colour zero, at most one rim successor colour one is allowed, and a 2-to-0 rim adjacency is forbidden, yielding exactly n+2 fixed rim words, hence 3(n+2). The explicitly displayed three-step update of (hub 1, rim 0^(n-4)1122) advances the hub three times and rotates its rim by one for n>=7, hence least temporal period 3n since the rim word has no shorter rotational symmetry and hub phase requires a multiple of three. The full labelled functional graph of 3^(n+1) states was independently recomputed for each n=3..7 (not sampled): n<=6 only fixed recurrent states; n=7 has 27 fixed points, exactly two primitive period-21 cycles, and period-21 basin size 168. The finite census covers only those five sizes; no general spectrum theorem is claimed for n>7.
